relevant_laws.quote: Where the signal is a steady red signal alone: Pedestrians facing such a signal shall not enter the highway, unless permitted to proceed by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283 [NRS-484B-283-1d1, NRS-484B-283-1d2, NRS-484B-283-1d3, NRS-484B-283-1d4].
relevant_laws.notes: Frozen pedestrian crossing cell; actual facing red and other-device indication require original review.
